evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to 16 ppm; it has stayed at 3–8 ppm since
Thermocouple followed the ramp setpoint within about 1 °C; brief overshoot to 760 °C at the start of growth, settled at 750 °C
Heater power holding steady at about 45% during growth, lower than the ramp peak as expected once no extra heating is needed
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint

args.missing_evidence: There is no pressure gauge and no normal-run reference data, so small drifts (e.g. in the thermocouple) can't be ruled out. No characterization of the sample yet.
